## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...)
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated (if code changed)
- [ ] Docs / README updated (if behaviour changed)
- [ ] No real bank statements, account numbers, GSTINs, PANs or other personal data in code, fixtures, screenshots or logs
